name: ManyChat DM Router
notes:
Receives a DM/comment-keyword event from ManyChat and routes it through the AICC lead pipeline. This workflow did NOT exist before this spec rollout — there was previously no connection at all between ManyChat and AICC.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
ONE-TIME SETUP (read before importing)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

STEP 1 — Prerequisite: run the sequence_track migration first
  This workflow calls a backend endpoint that depends on the leads.sequence_track
  column (backend/memory/migrations/004_sequence_track.sql). Run that SQL in
  Supabase Studio before using this workflow, or every lead it creates will
  default to no dedup protection.

STEP 2 — Import this workflow and copy its webhook URL
  After import, open the 'ManyChat Webhook' node and copy its Production URL
  (looks like https://YOUR_N8N_HOST/webhook/manychat-dm-router).

STEP 3 — In ManyChat, add an External Request action to each keyword flow
  For every keyword trigger you build in ManyChat (CLASS, HOME, SELL, LAND,
  PEARLAND, ROSHARON, IOWA COLONY, MANVEL, or a comment-trigger flow for
  ADDRESS), add an 'External Request' action that POSTs JSON to the webhook
  URL from Step 2, with a body like:
    { "keyword": "CLASS", "trigger": "dm", "platform": "instagram",
      "name": "{{full_name}}", "contact": "{{email or phone if collected}}",
      "post_id": "{{post_id}}", "subscriber_id": "{{subscriber_id}}" }
  Use ManyChat's own merge tags for name/contact/post_id/subscriber_id.

STEP 4 — Map the response back into ManyChat (optional but recommended)
  This workflow's response includes lead_magnet_url, routing_status, and
  routing_note. ManyChat's External Request action can map those JSON fields
  into custom user fields, so your next message can insert the guide link
  dynamically instead of hardcoding it per keyword.

STEP 5 — Check specs/aicc-social-spec.config.json before going live
  Several keywords (HOME, SELL, LAND, and all four neighborhood keywords) are
  marked "status": "needs_input" because no delivery URL for that lead magnet
  exists anywhere in this repo yet. Those DMs will still create and route the
  lead correctly, but lead_magnet_url will come back null, so ManyChat won't
  have a link to send. Add the missing URLs to that file (or tell AICC what
  they are) before turning those specific keyword flows on.

STEP 6 — Test and activate
  Send a test DM/comment with a real keyword, confirm a lead appears on the
  Leads page with source 'social' and the right lead_type, then toggle Active ON.
